styleSelection.reason: The reference depicts a sunlit Provençal hillside village in southern France rendered as an urban sketch: structural graphite and ink line work establishes the clustered stone houses, terracotta roofs, terrace walls, cypress spires, and foreground tree trunks over luminous light washes and concentrated shadow glazes.

village_walls_and_roofs.reason: Sunlit limestone facades, stone terrace walls, and terracotta roofs rely on crisp architectural line work over a light warm ochre-sienna wash while preserving sunlit paper highlights.

warm_terrace_slopes.reason: Sunlit ochre-green hillside terraces and warm dry-stone retaining walls keep an open light wash with linear contour accents.

sunlit_crown_greens.reason: Bright yellow-green tree crowns and sunlit lower-center foliage stay fresh and luminous over a single light wash.

olive_mid_canopy.reason: Mid-tone olive foliage and hillside transitions combine light sap-green and warm yellow washes with dark trunk and branch line work.

shaded_hillside_foliage.reason: Deep shaded olive canopy and under-tree masses need a controlled drier shadow glaze (band 4) alongside dark pen accents so foliage depth reads without muddying the light washes.

cypress_and_eave_darks.reason: Vertical cypress spires, deep foreground tree trunks, and upper-right roof and valley shadows require concentrated dark glazes and decisive closing ink.

families.referenceCue: Mid-value olive and hillside foliage bridging the terraced slopes and stone walls.
Bright sunlit yellow-green tree crowns and grassy terrace slope in the lower-center foreground.
Dark vertical cypress spires, deep tree trunks, and dark architectural eaves and cast shadows in the upper village.
Sunlit warm limestone house facades, stone terrace walls, and terracotta roofs clustered on the hillside.
Deep olive-green and cool-umber shadow masses beneath the tree canopy and across the upper-left and central hillside.
Warm sunlit ochre-green foliage and terraced hillside slopes across the left and lower-left middle ground.
